headline: Approved ratifying assistant election officials for the November 2026 General Election.
summary: Members adopted the meeting agenda unanimously, then adopted the consent agenda by unanimous vote. The consent agenda's only resolution covered the election officials, and the meeting then adjourned.
decisions: Approved the consent agenda, including a resolution ratifying the appointment of assistant election officials, 11-0 by unanimous vote.

decision_evidence.quote: Motion made by Councilor Schachter, seconded by Councilor Bergman, to adopt the consent agenda and take the actions indicated. Motion passed unanimously.
